reasoning_content:
404 for sign-up/email. Maybe auth base path differs, or signup uses a different route (e.g., /api/auth/signup, or custom /api/v1/auth/app-sign-in).

Let me probe POST endpoints:
- /api/auth/signup
- /api/auth/register
- /api/v1/auth/app-sign-in
- /api/auth/sign-in/email (to see if exists: POST → 400/401 rather than 404)

Let me test POST with dummy to distinguish 404 (no route) vs 400/401 (route exists).

action.command: cd /workspace/project && for p in "/api/auth/sign-up/email" "/api/auth/signup" "/api/auth/register" "/api/auth/sign-in/email" "/api/v1/auth/app-sign-in" "/api/auth/sign-up" ; do printf "%-32s POST " "$p"; code=$(curl -s -o /tmp/b.json -w "%{http_code}" --max-time 20 -X POST -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "Origin: https://app.claru.ai" -A "Mozilla/5.0" -d '{"email":"x@example.com","password":"Test1234!","name":"T"}' "https://app.claru.ai$p"); echo -n "$code "; head -c 120 /tmp/b.json | tr -d '\n'; echo; done
